build_random_irregular_mask: build random irregular masks for image inpainting using configurable line, circle, or square draw methods
create_rectangle_mask: create random rectangle masks with configurable size, margin, and overlap constraints
generate_superres_mask: generate random super-resolution masks with configurable step and width parameters
apply_outpainting_mask: apply outpainting-style edge padding masks with configurable side probabilities and fixed randomness
get_mixed_mask_embedder: get a mixed mask embedder that randomly selects from irregular, rectangle, full, segmentation, superres, and outpainting mask types
